marta: onboarding glyph-7b (llama->gemma-ish fusion). int4 looks fine speed-wise but falls apart on accented names and composed characters. short example below.
sunil: can you paste the fp32 vs int4 outputs? also which tokenizer normalizer did you pick?
marta:```
# prompt: summarize
FP32: "The report shows a 14% uplift in throughput and highlights implications for São Paulo deployment."
INT4: "Report shows 14% uplift.
Unrelated blurb about subscription tiers and an invented city name."
```
rex: newline/diacritic failures often point to tokenization differences (NFC vs NFKC) or a vocab aliasing happenstance. did we use the upstream tokenizer config?
marta: we used our fallback with NFKC. upstream specifies NFC and has a weird flag "rotary_decouple": true in config. i thought that was safe to ignore.
sunil: "rotary_decouple" huh. some model checkpoints emit separate per-head rotary gains (rotary_gain/headwise) when decoupled. our converter used a global inv_freq_scale which doesn't map cleanly -> after quant this makes attention phase drift. quant amplifies it.
rex: two vectors to fix: 1) restore upstream tokenizer normalizer (NFC) and ensure combining diacritics preserved; 2) handle rotary_decouple by emitting per-head rotary_gain and scaling with a small multiplier during quant.
sunil: quick convert tweak i used before:```
# convert_rotary handling
if cfg.get('rotary_decouple'):
    # create per-head gains from decoupled table
    gains = state['rotary_gains']
    for h in range(len(gains)):
        state['rotary_gain_per_head'][h] = gains[h] * cfg.get('rotary_hand_tweak', 0.92)
else:
    state['rotary_gain_global'] *= cfg.get('rotary_hand_tweak', 1.0)
```
marta: ok switched to upstream tokenizer (NFC + preserve_combining=true) and re-ran convert with rotary_hand_tweak=0.9 and per-channel int4 quant. reran eval overnight.
eval-bot: baseline(fp32): rouge-l 0.50 | exact-match 0.86 | factuality 0.94
int4(before): rouge-l 0.29 | exact-match 0.56 | factuality 0.59
int4(after): rouge-l 0.48 | exact-match 0.83 | factuality 0.91
rex: nice recovery. can we add a small onboarding unit: token_fingerprint for first 120 tokens (upstream vs converted) and a diacritic-smoke (20 names with combining marks) that fails the onboarding if >4% token diff or >6% factuality drop vs fp32?
marta: will add tests. also adding a converter assert to fail if model_cfg has rotary_decouple and we don't produce per-head gains. snippet i'll add:```
# convert sanity
if model_cfg.get('rotary_decouple') and 'rotary_gain_per_head' not in state:
    raise RuntimeError('rotary_decouple requested but per-head gains missing')
```
sunil: also note special token ids (bos/eos/pad) — mismatches there + diacritic token splits together explain many downstream hallucinations. add an automated check to compare special ids to upstream file.
marta: done. opening PR with tests, conversion note, and sample that triggered the bug. filed issue #5220 and tagged tokenizer, rotary, quant. rex: thanks for pointers.
rex: great work. leaving this thread as reference for other hybrid models with decoupled rotary params. :thumbsup:
